name: DiplomacyTurnStart
comment: Turn start: peace_years countdown (PEACEENDDLG), then handles the mailbox player+0x671+sender*6, types 1..11

name: Msg_TributeDemand
comment: Mailbox type 2: tribute demand; answers with type 3/4

name: Msg_TributeAnswer
comment: Mailbox type 3/4 (mode 0/1): answer to a tribute demand

name: Msg_Negotiation
comment: Mailbox types 5..11: trade/peace offers and their answers (sends 7/8, 10/11)

name: Ai_AnswerTrade
comment: Computer answer to a trade offer (7/8)

name: Ai_AnswerPeace
comment: Computer answer to a peace offer (10/11)

name: Ai_AnswerTribute
comment: Computer answer to a tribute demand (3/4)

name: SabotageBaseChance
comment: byte[15] base success % per sabotage type 1..14
